coordinate_calibration.provenance: Physical scan window reconstructed from the stored PSV camera frame of SP13_a_500by500_Glue420_Auxetic_newSP01_260910.svd (registration_evidence/SP13_physical_registration_reconstruction.json, sha256 6b45fbfbacad0df939b0b12f8496edddff0525855e0de0312ff5f558c71bb0ae): PSV MeasPoints video coordinates validated against the UNV geometry, panel edges fitted in the frame, physical scale from the measured panel dimensions 510 x 520 mm (spec; steel ruler and calipers, no instrument uncertainty recorded). The UNV metric coordinates are anisotropic (x 1.195, y 0.889 of physical); this per-axis camera-grid scale replaces them. No modal data or MAC were used.

measured_surface.label: labelled exterior face measured by the scanner (HUMAN H3); bound to FE TOP by convention: the face sign is not demonstrable from records (FE stack is through-thickness symmetric)

orientation.source: panel edges fitted in the stored PSV frame (reconstruction record above); handwritten label at the physical top edge (HUMAN H2); lattice orientation as in the Abaqus model (HUMAN H4); the 510 mm side is horizontal (frame aspect). FE axis signs are not determinable from records: the nominal +x->+X, +y->+Y continues the accepted legacy convention and was fixed before any pairing evaluation; the three alternatives are recorded in the evidence

geometry_file.role: FE node coordinates (instance,node_label,x,y,z) extracted from the CARBON-4C reference ODB

acquisition.remount_evidence: HUMAN H6 (SUPERVISOR-accepted 2026-10-06): the panel was removed from the suspension after 260909 and re-suspended; laser/scanner and shaker installation not moved; SP-13 marking visible in both stored frames.
